items.name: format-date
items.title: Format Date
items.description: Locale-aware date formatting with presets (short, medium, long, datetime, time) and formatRelative for '3 minutes ago'. Intl only, zero dependencies.
items.author: Tanfust <https://tanfust.com>

items.name: format-currency
items.title: Format Currency
items.description: Format prices from minor units (cents) the way payment APIs return them, with locale and currency options, plus formatCompact for 1.2K-style numbers. Intl only.
items.author: Tanfust <https://tanfust.com>

items.name: absolute-url
items.title: Absolute Url
items.description: Build absolute URLs for the current deployment from a path, detecting the origin from NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL, VITE_APP_URL, APP_URL, VERCEL_URL or window.location. For OG images, emails and webhooks.
items.author: Tanfust <https://tanfust.com>

items.name: slugify
items.title: Slugify
items.description: URL-safe slugs: strips accents, lowercases, collapses separators, optional max length; uniqueSlug appends -2, -3 against a taken set.
items.author: Tanfust <https://tanfust.com>
